title: 心太阳与工具月亮
description: This fun resource pack completely transforms the sky! It replaces the warm sun with a cute pixel-art heart, and throughout the full moon cycle, the moon changes into a Diamond Sword, Diamond Pickaxe, Diamond Shovel, and finally a Diamond Axe. Add a unique
body:
◆ Creative Concept ◆
Tired of the vanilla sun and moon being a bit too plain? This resource pack delivers a whole new sky filled with love and a spirit of adventure! The sun becomes a warm, heartfelt pixel-art heart, while the moon showcases the core of Minecraft—tools—symbolizing that every night is a new beginning for exploration and creation.

◆ Resource Pack Content ◆
Sun Texture: Replaced with a bright pixel-art heart.

Moon Texture: The moon cycles through 8 major phases, each displaying a different diamond tool:
Diamond Sword → Diamond Pickaxe → Diamond Shovel → Diamond Axe

Resolution: 16x (stays true to the classic vanilla style and low-config friendly!)

◆ Important Notes ◆
This is a client-side resource pack. It does not need to be installed on the server and is only visible to you.

May conflict with other packs that modify the sky, sun, or moon. For best results, place this pack at the top of your resource pack list to ensure priority.

Compatible with most vanilla-style resource packs and shaders.

Supported Version: 1.20.1 (though likely compatible with many other versions—please verify before downloading).
